reason: Primary purpose is Tencent QQ Agent Mail integration for DeepSeek Harness, exposing a service and 14 tools to authenticate, list/read/search/watch, send/reply/forward, manage folders/trash/delete, and download attachments, which classifies it as an external-services integration plugin with moderate mailbox-access risk.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 提供腾讯 QQ 邮箱（QQ Agent Mail）集成，可在模型工具中进行邮件的认证、读取、搜索、发送、回复、转发、删除和附件下载等操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds Tencent QQ Agent Mail capabilities to DeepSeek Harness, enabling authentication plus mail list/read/search/send/reply/forward/delete operations and attachment download through native tools and watch events.

capabilities: Read, search, and monitor QQ Agent Mail inbox data via native tools and event streams
Send, reply, forward, trash, and delete messages through provided tooling
Authenticate with QQ Agent Mail via OAuth and account status checks
Resolve and invoke the QQ Agent Mail CLI and download attachments with large-attachment handling

reasons.code: The README lists QQ Mail tools including qq_mail_list, qq_mail_read, qq_mail_search, qq_mail_send, qq_mail_reply, qq_mail_forward, qq_mail_trash, qq_mail_delete, and qq_mail_watch, indicating direct mailbox access and message manipulation.
The plugin supports OAuth login status and whoami workflows, showing account-level access to external email data and operations.
The dependency on @tencent-qqmail/agently-cli indicates the plugin delegates email actions to an external CLI runtime for account integration and execution.
